hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: G0001 is recovered as F(x,y) = (f(x)-f(y))/(x-y). G0002 is recovered as the limit of F(x,v) as v -> x, giving df(x).
required_assumptions: x and y are independent symbolic variables
the limit v -> x of (f(x)-f(v))/(x-v) equals df(x)
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The two catalog members are the non-coincident and coincident-node forms of a first divided difference. G0001 is the secant quotient; G0002 is the derivative obtained as the coincident-node limit.
